name: K-wise moment-matched merging with L2-optimal amplitude
definition: A level-of-detail merging technique that combines K splats into a single representative splat by matching moments and optimizing the resulting amplitude via L2 loss.
summary: K-wise moment-matched merging with L2-optimal amplitude reduces Gaussian splat clusters by matching statistical moments and optimizing amplitude to minimize integrated squared error, distinguishing itself from simple averaging.
